Time Signature: 4/4

This is hymn number 165 titled "Abide with Me; 'Tis Eventide" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook.

The music was composed by Harrison Millard and the lyrics were written by M. Lowrie Hofford.
